assertions.name: archimedean_per_block_beats_bar_length_at_q0
assertions.source: At the substrate anchor q₀ the archimedean per-block Σ y_λ|χ(q₀)| lands closer to AME than the bar-length Σ y_λ√(χ(q₀)·χ(q₀⁻¹)) for every tested isotope (D: +3.6% vs −70.3%). The bar is the correct CATEGORICAL/fibre norm (per #1738) but its archimedean realization is |χ(q₀)|, not the mirror pairing — the growth channels (χ(q₀)·χ(q₀⁻¹)<0, imaginary bar-length) are the obstruction. Recorded so the observation step is not naively bar-ified.

description: DERIVATION (0 fit): per-block binding via the Hecke BAR-pairing ‖χ^λ‖_bar = √(χ^λ(q₀)·χ^λ(q₀⁻¹)) (bar-involution q↦q⁻¹; non-archimedean, defined over any base ring) vs the archimedean per-block |χ^λ(q₀)|. y_λ Wenzl (bar-symmetrized), χ^λ Hoefsmit at q₀ and q₀⁻¹. E_0=m_e/(q₀(q₀−1)) calibration. Light isotopes D, T; AME comparison only. Growth-channel tally records λ with χ(q₀)·χ(q₀⁻¹) < 0 (imaginary bar-length — q-Reeb arccosh channels).
